adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies that the Group model in discourse/models/group.js now contains both pagination state (limit, offset, user_count) and admin-only methods (removeMember, addMembers) that call /admin/groups/ endpoints. This model is used by both the public group-members route (discourse/routes/group-members.js.es6) and admin routes. The public group/members.hbs template iterates over 'members' which is now set by findMembers(). While the admin methods would fail with 403 if called from non-admin context, the coupling of admin API contracts into a shared model is a legitimate architectural/maintainability concern that the diff introduces.
